title: Stationary velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of the electron drift velocity as v_s = E/B.

title: Hall resistance expression
description: Essential: Derives the classical Hall resistance as R_H = φ/(eN) or an equivalent correct form.

title: Electron-to-flux quantum ratio
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the filling factor N/N_φ = 1/3 for the given plateau R_H = 3h/e^2.

title: Scaling exponent for energy
description: Important: Correctly determines the scaling exponent α = 1/2 for the energy gain ΔU ∝ B^α.

title: Magnetic field change for quasihole
description: Important: Correctly calculates ΔB = h/(eWL) for the introduction of one quasihole.

title: Thermal energy calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates E_th = k_B T with correct numerical value for T = 1.0 K.

title: Kinetic energy estimate
description: Important: Uses uncertainty principle to estimate kinetic energy, yielding an order of magnitude ~10^-20 J.

title: Noise-to-current ratio
description: Essential: Correctly derives the final ratio S_I / I_B = νe.

title: Incorrect Hall resistance dependence
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly makes R_H depend on sample dimensions (W, L) instead of only φ and N.

title: Sign or unit error in charge
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign or magnitude (e vs e/3) for quasiparticle charge in current/noise expressions.
